items.source: This annotation serves as a specialization of @Component, allowing for implementation classes to be autodetected through classpath scanning.
items.translation: 此注解是 `@Component` 的特化版本，允许通过类路径扫描自动检测实现类。

items.source:
May also indicate that a class is a "Business Service Facade" (in the Core J2EE
patterns sense), or something similar. This annotation is a general-purpose stereotype
and individual teams may narrow their semantics and use as appropriate.
items.translation: 也可能表示该类是一个“业务服务外观”（在核心 J2EE 模式的意义下），或类似的东西。此注解是一个通用立体结构，各个团队可以缩小其语义并酌情使用。
